# Correlation Matrix of Ligand and Receptor Pairs
```{r}
#############Correlation Matrix other#####################################
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

NRCAF <- c("WNT5A", "WNT11", "NRP1", "NEGR1", "SEMA3A", "SEMA3C")
EPI <- c("FZD5", "RYK", "ROR1", "ROR2", "NRP1", "VEGFA", "SEMA3B", "FGFR2")

# Make sure you have loaded NR_CAF and Epithelial objects first
DefaultAssay(NR_CAF) <- "CorrectedCounts"
DefaultAssay(Epithelial) <- "CorrectedCounts"

NRcaf_df <- as.data.frame(t(GetAssayData(NR_CAF, layer = "data")[NRCAF, ]))
NRcaf_df$patient_id <- NR_CAF@meta.data$patient_id
caf_avg <- NRcaf_df %>% group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(NRCAF), mean, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_NRCAF"), .cols = NRCAF)

epi_df <- as.data.frame(t(GetAssayData(Epithelial, layer = "data")[EPI, ]))
epi_df$patient_id <- Epithelial@meta.data$patient_id
epi_avg <- epi_df %>% group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(EPI), mean, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_EPI"), .cols = EPI)

merged <- inner_join(caf_avg, epi_avg, by="patient_id")

caf_cols <- intersect(paste0(NRCAF, "_NRCAF"), colnames(merged))
epi_cols <- intersect(paste0(EPI, "_EPI"), colnames(merged))

nonzero_caf <- caf_cols[sapply(caf_cols, function(g) {
  vals <- merged[[g]]
  is.numeric(vals) && sum(!is.na(vals)) > 1 && var(vals, na.rm = TRUE) != 0
})]
nonzero_epi <- epi_cols[sapply(epi_cols, function(g) {
  vals <- merged[[g]]
  is.numeric(vals) && sum(!is.na(vals)) > 1 && var(vals, na.rm = TRUE) != 0
})]

cor_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(nonzero_epi), ncol = length(nonzero_caf),
                     dimnames = list(nonzero_epi, nonzero_caf))
for(i in seq_along(nonzero_caf)){
  for(j in seq_along(nonzero_epi)){
    x <- merged[[nonzero_caf[i]]]
    y <- merged[[nonzero_epi[j]]]
    if(is.numeric(x) && is.numeric(y) && !all(is.na(x)) && !all(is.na(y))){
      cor_matrix[j, i] <- cor(x, y, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    }
  }
}

# Remove any all-NA rows/cols
cor_matrix <- cor_matrix[rowSums(!is.na(cor_matrix)) > 0, colSums(!is.na(cor_matrix)) > 0]
pheatmap(cor_matrix, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE)

pheatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = round(cor_matrix, 2),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101) # scale from -1 to +1, default colors
)
```

# Cell Chat
```{r}
#CELL CHAT##

# subset out smaller and contaminating cell populations. They will not be part of the analysis.
table(Idents(longituindal_gol))
merged <- subset(longituindal_gol, idents = c("CD4T", "CD8T", "Granulocyte", "Epi", "B-Cell", "Macrophage", "Pericyte", "NK", "Endothelial", "TReg", "CAF", "agCAF"))

Idents(merged) <- "passed_level1labels"
levels(merged)

DefaultAssay(merged) <- "CorrectedCounts"
#You will want to make sure your data is normalized
merged_longitudinal <- NormalizeData(merged)
merged_longitdudinal <- ScaleData(merged)
```
## Create the CellChat Object------------------------------------
```{r}
cellChat <- createCellChat(object = merged_longitudinal, group.by = "passed_level1labels", assay = "CorrectedCounts")

rm(merged_longitudinal)
rm(merged)

CellChat.list <- list(cellChat)
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human
```

## Running CellChat --------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#Level1Labels should be the metadata 
CellChat.list <- lapply(CellChat.list, function(x){
  x@DB <- CellChatDB
  cellchat <- subsetData(x)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat@meta$passed_level1labels <- factor(cellchat@meta$passed_level1labels)
  cellchat@meta$passed_level1labels <- droplevels(cellchat@meta$passed_level1labels,
                                        exclude = setdiff(levels(cellchat@meta$passed_level1labels),unique(as.character(cellchat@meta$passed_level1labels))))
  cellchat@idents <- cellchat@meta$passed_level1labels
  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat)
  cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
  return(cellchat)
})

CellChat.list 
#saveRDS(CellChat.list, "../OBJECTS/GOL_CELL_CHAT_LIST_tumor_onlt.rds")
```

## Plotting cell chat results
```{r}
#CellChat.list <- readRDS("../OBJECTS/GOL_CELL_CHAT_LIST_tumor_onlt.rds")

T1 <- CellChat.list[[1]]

# Interaction Weight / Strength -------------------------------------------

## cell-cell communication strength tables
T1@net$weight 

## Plotting communication strength
netVisual_circle(T1@net$weight, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(T1@idents)), arrow.size = 0.1,
                 weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "T1 interaction strength", margin = 0.01)

netVisual_heatmap(T1, measure = "count", color.heatmap = "Reds",  title.name = "Number of interactions T1")

#Merge the two cell chat objects for comparative analysis
#T1pathways.show.all <- T1@netP$pathways
#pathways <- as.data.frame(T1pathways.show.all)
T1 <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(T1, slot.name = "netP")
CellChat <- T1
CellChat@options$datatype <- "CorrectedCounts"

CellChat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(CellChat)
netVisual_circle(T1@net$weight, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(T1@idents)), arrow.size = 0.1,
                 weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "T1 interaction strength", margin = 0.01)
```
